synth.notes:
Arrows move selected block sprites or the horizontal mirror axis.
Action 5 cycles axis then pieces by descending size; rendering re-extracts names and occlusion.
A continuity-gated 128-action budget is capped at 64 visible cells; depletion shifts player names +1.
Action 7 undoes the last successful movement, preserving selection and budget.
Click behavior, equal-size selection ties, and full budget exhaustion remain unobserved.
